text: Traders bought Jon Ossoff overnight, pushing the blended price up 1.2 points to 26.7. Both books agreed on the direction, with Polymarket moving 1.4 points and Kalshi 1.0 point. The odds that Chris Murphy enters the race fell 17 points on Kalshi, to 20 percent, even though Murphy's nomination price barely moved. Jon Ossoff leads the markets at 26.7, but the model likes Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who wins 27.0 percent of 50,000 simulated primaries. About 11 in 100 simulated primaries end without a pledged majority, which sends the fight to the convention floor. Watch the Ossoff price first when the books update tonight. We also changed how the model works today, which accounts for much of its movement.
